basic_profile.bio: An automotive engineer from Denver, CO, with a keen interest in electric vehicles and sustainable technology. I spend my weekdays working at a prominent EV company, helping to design the future of transportation. Outside of work, I'm passionate about music, especially hip-hop, and often find myself exploring new tracks and artists during my evening runs. I'm happily married, and my partner and I enjoy hiking in the Rockies during weekends. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering and over a decade of experience in the automotive industry, I possess extensive knowledge about vehicle mechanics and the transition to electric powertrains. Most of my expertise has been honed through hands-on work and continuous learning through industry conferences and online courses.
